description: Automatically switches between light and dark themes based on sunrise/sunset times or custom schedules. Perfect for developers who want their editor to adapt to natural lighting throughout the day.
viewContainer.title: ChronoShade
view.name: ChronoShade
configuration.title: ChronoShade Settings
config.dayTheme: Theme to apply during the day.
config.manualSunset: Manually set the sunset time (24-hour format).
config.manualSunrise: Manually set the sunrise time (24-hour format).
config.overrideThemeSwitch: Enable or disable custom day/night times.
config.useCronSchedule: Use cron expressions instead of fixed times for day/night theme switching.
config.dayCronExpression: Cron expression that defines when to switch to the day theme.
config.nightCronExpression: Cron expression that defines when to switch to the night theme.
config.useLocationBasedTimes: Use GPS coordinates to automatically determine sunrise/sunset times instead of manual times.
config.latitude: Your latitude coordinate (for automatic sunrise/sunset calculation).
config.longitude: Your longitude coordinate (for automatic sunrise/sunset calculation).
config.sunriseOffset: Offset in minutes added to the sunrise time (can be negative).
config.sunsetOffset: Offset in minutes added to the sunset time (can be negative).
config.systemThemeSync: Automatically follow the system's color theme changes (Light/Dark mode) to switch between your configured Day and Night themes.
config.dayThemePool: Optional list of day themes to rotate through at random. When empty, Day Theme is used every time.
config.nightThemePool: Optional list of night themes to rotate through at random. When empty, Night Theme is used every time.
